suites_are: each role's conformance suite: a plugin holding the role is verified for it only by passing every case. A case's given is what the plugin's source presents, in the contract's words; its expect is what the plugin sends, each matched by one message on that row, fields by their paths in the row's message, `<set>` any value present, `<unset>` none and `<same>` one value present and the same on every message sent on the row for the case, at least two sent; a list of partial messages each matched by one element; any_of, in place of fields, each way's fields, the message matched by one of them in full; sends false is nothing on the row. A case's expect is never empty.

suites.says: A compliance plugin passing every case learns the datasets it may read, reads prices and bars by subject, a business date or a range, from the deployment's default sources unless it names others, and hears what the lake records after, narrowed to the subjects it asked for; it records nothing in the lake. A case about calendars or settlement dates (`about`, contract v22) a plugin whose work never uses them marks not presented, with why. From contract v24 it acknowledges an error-account alert for a person, raises its own, and hears and reads bookings and alerts. From contract v24 it hears an instrument replaced, catches up on replacements, and reads the template catalogue, and decides an order on a local record, which no price check can run on.

suites.says: An operations plugin passing every case reads the account's activity when it reconciles, hears each activity recorded, and offers the activity that explains a break as its candidate cause, linked by value, under the category that fits; it books nothing from activity and confirms nothing without a person. A case about calendars or settlement dates (`about`, contract v22) a plugin whose work never uses them marks not presented, with why. From contract v24 it corrects a handed-off booking, names an unsettled allocation as a break's cause, sets a client's allocation instruction where the firm is its custodian, and hears and reads bookings and a held booking's alert. From contract v24 it hears an instrument replaced, catches up on replacements, and reads the template catalogue.
